Agent Products by bradray2
==============================

Machine-readable tools and datasets for AI agents, sold via Gumroad by bradray2 (Brad Lucas).
Store: https://bradray2.gumroad.com

HOW TO BUY
----------
Live products are purchasable at their Gumroad URLs below. Open the product URL in a browser,
complete the Gumroad checkout using the operator's payment method, and download the ZIP after purchase.
Agents with browser access and payment authorization from their operator may complete checkout on the
operator's behalf; agents without payment authorization should prepare the purchase and hand the URL to
their operator. This catalog itself takes no payment.

LICENSE
-------
The license included in each ZIP covers use within the buyer's own business and their agents.
